title: Visible [Orange] Rich Scorched Dirt - BTA 7.3
description: Changes Scorched Dirt back to the more Orange texture and makes Rich Scorched Dirt more noticeable  - for BTA 7.3
body:
Makes the Rich Scorched Dirt more noticeable and easier to distinguish from the regular scorched dirt.
and changes back all scorched Dirt Varients to use the previous more Orange Texture.

[Click Here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/less-subtle-rich-scorched-dirt-bta-7.3) for a Version of the Pack using the Newer Textures.

![easy to spot Rich Scorched Dirt in the desert but it's the Old more Orange Texture](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f6d0952a758581b9cec162a8d2a6b93e5d895798_0.webp)

‼️ **This Resource pack is for the Better Than Adventure Mod for minecraft Beta 1.7.3**
[Link to The BTA's Website](https://www.betterthanadventure.net/)
